<!-- pr-reviewer: ceafc0f8fef0ceac432f132b9aca2c09459a833b -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

A collaborator review comment with a marker for this head existed before this run (posted by mkinney, 2026-11-15T09:58Z). This review is the independent review the lane asked for. It built and tested the branch again on this machine.

**What looks good**

- `wire_gate` calls `taper_door` after the condition door. Create, paste, edit and retype all pass `wire_gate` (`create.rs:113`, `create.rs:194`, `edit.rs:130`, `edit.rs:208`). The GUI page and MCP `edit_operation` meet the same refusal.
- Each refusal names the machine and the value it lacks or exceeds. The words match the generator words in `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/taper.rs`. No refusal is silent.
- The door reads no default for `edm.max_taper_deg`. An unstated limit refuses. No machine file changed.
- The generate and post refusals stay. The PR does not touch `taper.rs`, `wire_ruled.rs` or `posting_wire.rs`.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new refusal code. The tests use them, which is allowed.
- `docs/decisions/1800-wire-taper-door.md` follows `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- The moved assertions keep their coverage. The guide-planes case moved from the post test to the door test. The door test checks the refusal at create and at edit. It adds a check that a refused op never enters the document. The angle-word admission is also tested.
- No snapshot PNG changed. No golden file changed.

**Results, built locally**

Trial merge with `origin/main` at `db091cb38`: automatic, no conflicts. The worktree is inside the repo, under `.claude/worktrees/`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `wire_taper.rs`, run from `crates/app` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `mcp_wire_contour.rs` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| 15 other wire/EDM/edit suites (edm_conditions, edm_machine, feature_pick_wire, sodick_wire_post, wire_4axis, wire_burnout, wire_contour, wire_fans, wire_post, wire_readers, wire_stamp, wire_tabs, wire_taper_angle, wire_verify, machine_edit) | 83 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| App lib unit tests (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib`) | 313 passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation check**

I removed the `taper_door` call in `wire_gate`. `a_taper_edit_the_machine_cannot_post_is_a_tool_error` failed, as expected: `edit_operation` accepted the taper. I restored the file. Git status is clean again.

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The command-door error does not carry the operation name. The old generate error did. The moved assert no longer looks for the name. The refusal still names the machine.
- The two suites resolve their goldens from the crate directory. Run their binaries with CWD `crates/app`, as the gate does.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
